hooks.name: Run tests after spec task
hooks.description: After each spec task finishes, run the fast suite (npm run test:fast, without the property-test folders). After a checkpoint task or the last task of a spec, run the full suite (npm test). Report a summary of any failures to the user.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. If the task title starts with 'Checkpoint' or it is the last task of the spec, run `npm test` (the full suite, about 3 minutes, including tests/**/properties/). Otherwise run `npm run test:fast` (every test except the tests/**/properties/ folders, which take about 80% of the run time). Run once from the repository root; never use watch mode. If it exits with code 0, say in one line which suite ran, that all tests passed, and the test count. If it fails, tell the user in Traditional Chinese which suite ran, how many tests failed, and for each failing test the file, the test name, and the key assertion or error message (expected vs. received, or the first error line). Keep the summary short, do not paste the full log, and do not try to fix the failures unless the user asks.
